svg.title: ULBP stress recognition by NKG2D
svg.desc: ULBPs possess α1/α2-like stress-ligand domains without a peptide-presenting groove, α3 domain or β2m. Individual ULBP membrane attachment varies. Native editable vector; domain cartoons are not atomic models.
